name: m5-scaling
description: Scalability: 1 to 16 concurrent compiles in one JVM (each its own table), G1, a fixed 8 GB heap, Graal 25.4.4, on the M5 Pro laptop (6 P + 12 E cores). Hypothesis: at N=1 spare cores absorb G1's extra work (card scanning, copying, concurrent refinement), masking the chained table's cost; as N approaches the core count that work competes with the mutators, and `chained-weak` falls behind `chunked-weak`. Score is time per compile; throughput is N / score.
